task: Search 'CVPR 2023' and 'CVPR2023' through journal ref on ArXiv to see how many results there are respectively.
answer:
FINAL: On arXiv, searching the Journal reference field for CVPR 2023 returned 54 results; CVPR2023 returned 9 results, respectively. Both searches included all dates and cross-listed papers (checked October 27, 2026).

Evidence: arXiv displayed “Showing 1–50 of 54 results” for journal_ref=CVPR 2023 and “Showing 1–9 of 9 results” for journal_ref=CVPR2023.

CVPR 2023 source: https://arxiv.org/search/advanced?advanced=1&terms-0-operator=AND&terms-0-term=CVPR+2023&terms-0-field=journal_ref&classification-physics_archives=all&classification-include_cross_list=include&date-filter_by=all_dates&date-year=&date-from_date=&date-to_date=&date-date_type=submitted_date&abstracts=show&size=50&order=-announced_date_first
CVPR2023 source: https://arxiv.org/search/advanced?advanced=&terms-0-operator=AND&terms-0-term=CVPR2023&terms-0-field=journal_ref&classification-physics_archives=all&classification-include_cross_list=include&date-filter_by=all_dates&date-year=&date-from_date=&date-to_date=&date-date_type=submitted_date&abstracts=show&size=50&order=-announced_date_first
